OnlyPoetry

Reproducibility control for BasalCellDemo using a Poetry-only Python environment

Project Summary

OnlyPoetry is a reproducibility control for BasalCellDemo. It retrieves the same pyproject.toml and poetry.lock used by BasalCellDemo and reconstructs the Python environment using Poetry alone, without the Mamba-managed environment provided by BasalCell.

Author(s)

  • Yuji Okano <yujiokano@keio.jp>

    • GitHub account: yo-aka-gene

Setting Up the Environment

  1. Clone this repository to your local environment.

  2. Run the initialization command:

make init
